newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK gold closes at day's low on late selling.
newsitem.headline: HK gold closes at day's low on late selling.

text.p: Hong Kong gold extended its early losses to close at the day's low on Monday, reversing course from New York's higher close on Friday, dealers said.
Bullion ended at US$351.50/352.00 an ounce, down from New York's US$352.60/353.10 close on Friday and Saturday's local close of US$352.70/353.20.
"There was selling from traders in the Far East and overseas," said a dealer at a local investment house. "But I think gold recovered and held at US$350 where it found solid support."
Physical buying was brisk at these levels, the dealer said.
"The market is waiting for the U.S. Federal Open Market Committee meeting on Tuesday," another dealer said. "Traders expect U.S. interest rates to rise by a quarter point."
Local gold ended HK$7 lower at HK$3,258 a tael.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver
Exchange Society rose to zero from its Saturday fix at -0.05.
Hong Kong close - US$351.50/352.00 New York close - US$352.60/353.10
